linear_r1_to_r2.note: face areas are construction-independent (grade A); the volume is exact for the normal-section construction, see envelope_vs_section for the rolling-ball envelope

controlPoints_1_2_1.note: OCCT Add(TColgp_Array1OfPnt2d) interpolates (smooth); the piecewise-linear figures are the llull `interpolation: "linear"` law only. Radii AT control points are exact for both.

envelope_vs_section.law: r(z) = 1 + 0.05 z on the 20-long edge (slope dr/ds = 0.05)
envelope_vs_section.meaning: the two constructions differ by this fraction of removed area at slope 0.05 (grows ~ slope^2); volume VCs on variable fillets use a tolerance that covers it until the native construction is pinned (open question Q2)
